Services And Pricing

Note: Prices are a best-guess estimate - prices vary based on input costs that may differ.

Also note that we are rather* flexible in how we can implement solutions - from reducing the scope of work in the short-term (to lessen immediate costs), to particular arrangements on ownership/revenue sharing opportunities (to acheive a reduced total cost), to more favourable initial cost with the promise of future business.

Please contact us for more information on prices and services that we offer.

The 'Basic'

  • Used for:
    • Product marketing.
    • Small/medium business online presence.
    • Personal brand building - achieve further reach than Social media alone.
  • Included for free (when chosing 'The Startup' plan)

ZAR900

For once-off initial cost of the first version of a website. Please note that this cost may vary based on input costs such as domain name registration/renewal fees.

+ ZAR200 extra

For any changes required after the first version (within a 28 day period after payment.)

The 'Startup'

  • Used for:
    • Web-based applications to improve business operations, cut costs (elimintate redundancies), increase revenue (obtain business insights), etc.

    • Full web-application with capabilities including data persistence, user authentication, etc.
  • Please contact us for more information on services offered.

Please contact us for more information on pricing. Note that prices are negotiable under flexible terms such as timelines and scope of development work (developing a most-viable product first at a reduced cost while the business tests an idea)

The 'No Vibes' Coder

  • Used For:

    • Assisting with business owner 'vibe coding' endeavours.
    • Existing business software that desires automation from AI tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Copilot, etc.

ZAR5,000

For initial existing software consult.

+ ZAR500 extra
